Welcome to the R Project blog! Here, members of the R Core Team and the R
Foundation, along with other contributors, share news, insights, and plans
related to the R core implementation and other related topics.

The blog posts represent individual opinions of their authors. Unless stated
so explicitly, they should not be taken as positions of R Core or the R
Foundation. 

In the interest of technical quality of the posts, the authors may modify
existing posts after publication.
